title: MCP Directory Ingestor
purpose: Enrich mcp_server_registry with mentions from known authoritative and community-curated MCP directories. Presence in Anthropic's reference list (modelcontextprotocol.io/servers) is the single strongest trust signal in the ecosystem; presence in multiple community aggregators is weaker but additive. Phase II of SENTINEL_ROADMAP_v2.md.

pilot_spec.description: Ingest ONLY the Anthropic reference list (modelcontextprotocol.io/servers) as pilot. Parse the HTML or JSON, extract MCP names and repo URLs, match to existing server_ids in mcp_server_registry via name or URL fuzzy match. Write to mcp_directory_mentions table. Report: how many entries found in the reference list, how many matched existing registry entries, how many are NEW (i.e., Anthropic lists MCPs we don't yet have in our registry — these are high-value imports). Halt before adding other directories if Anthropic ingestion doesn't produce at least 15 matches.
pilot_spec.candidate_selection: N/A — single-directory pilot rather than candidate MCPs
success_criteria: at least 15 entries parsed from the reference list
at least 10 of those match existing registry entries (sanity check on name normalization)
any new-to-us MCPs are written to a 'discovery_candidate' queue for operator review before being added to the main registry
no more than 3 HTTP requests to modelcontextprotocol.io (one for the page; two for retries if needed)
abort_conditions: modelcontextprotocol.io returns non-200 — assume temporary outage, retry once, then abort cleanly
parse yields <5 entries (page structure changed — needs operator review of the parser before reruns)
any attempt to fetch more than 3 URLs — pilot is strictly the one index page

exported_functions.name: ingest_anthropic_reference
exported_functions.description: One-shot pilot function. Fetches the reference list once, parses, matches, writes. Returns summary dict with counts.

exported_functions.name: ingest_all_directories
exported_functions.description: Full daemon cycle — iterates all configured directories. NOT called during pilot. Only invoked after pilot success and operator approval.

mcp_discovery_candidates.purpose: MCPs mentioned in directories but not yet in our registry. Operator reviews before promotion.

rate_limit_discipline.doctrine: Weekly refresh for directories. Directory contents change slowly; no value in daily hammering.

per_directory_limits.anthropic_reference: 1 fetch per week, User-Agent identifying us, respect any robots.txt directive
per_directory_limits.mcp_so: weekly; if they have an API, use it; otherwise HTML parse politely

rate_limit_discipline.cycle_interval: 7 days in production; pilot is one-shot

matching_logic.strategy: Match directory entry to registry by: (1) exact name match, (2) name match modulo scope prefix (@owner/pkg vs pkg), (3) exact repo URL match, (4) repo URL normalization (strip .git suffix, www. prefix, trailing slash). If no match found, entry goes to mcp_discovery_candidates for operator review — DO NOT auto-insert into mcp_server_registry.
normalization_examples: '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem' matches 'modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem' and 'server-filesystem' when ecosystem context is npm
case-sensitive match should be preferred; case-insensitive match is fallback with evidence noting the case mismatch

forbidden: DO NOT write new MCPs directly to mcp_server_registry — all new discoveries go through mcp_discovery_candidates for operator approval
DO NOT cache HTML — extract structured data and discard the raw
DO NOT ignore robots.txt on any directory source
DO NOT assume URL stability — accept that directories will restructure, fail gracefully with clear parser error

quarantine_integration.gate_8_expected_contract: directory_presence_signal should show at least 4 distinct values across 50+ MCPs (presence in 0, 1, 2-3, 4+ directories). If all MCPs land in the same bucket, directory enrichment is broken.

acceptance_tests: ingest_anthropic_reference() completes under 30 seconds with pilot candidates
mcp_directory_mentions has at least 10 rows after pilot
ingesting twice produces no duplicates (upsert semantics honored)
if modelcontextprotocol.io returns 404 mid-parse, module exits cleanly with no partial writes
